thread:
Noah: quick brain-dump  prototyping an inline model preview for the catalog rows. shows main perf badge, version picker, and a tiny "+ compare" toggle. prototype: https://figma.redwood/inline-preview
Lena: nice. main concerns: badge clutter with lots of metrics, and keyboard discoverability.
Ishaan (a11y): a11y: hover previews must not move focus. use aria-live for hover summaries. pressing Enter should open a persistent, tabbable overlay. give badges full aria-labels like "Typical latency (p50): 88 ms".
Noah: agree. plan: hover->aria-live announce (debounced 450ms), Enter->overlay with tabbable controls and Esc to return focus. primary badge visible; others behind small chevron.
Savita: product note: customers want quick multi-select for compare. put an unobtrusive checkbox in the overlay that syncs to the compare state.
Lena: microcopy: change tooltip text from `p50 latency` to `Typical latency (p50)` and use sentence case in headers.
Ishaan (a11y): test list: NVDA/VoiceOver hover announce, keyboard open/close, add-to-compare via keyboard, badge labelling, and no double announcements on rapid hover.
CI-Bot: preview available on branch feat/catalog/inline-preview  https://staging.redwood/inline-preview (build #548).
Noah: action items: Noah update figma (EOD), Ishaan write a11y checklist, Lena curate badge priority, Savita update docs. I'll ping when PR is ready.
